text:
people-ops: Hey team — launching a new Civic & Volunteer Leave policy pilot starting Apr 1 (FY26).

people-ops: Key points: 5 days/year separate leave bucket for volunteering or civic duties, eligible after 90 days, separate from regular PTO, non-transferable and does not roll over during the 6-month pilot. Request via the People Portal. Feedback requested. :wave: 

elaine: Thanks! Is this separate from PTO or does it draw from our existing balance?

sam: Also — will we get travel reimbursements if volunteering requires travel?

hr-bot: Policy doc + request form: https://intra.redwood.com/hr/volunteer-leave (PDF + form)

people-ops: Short answers: 1) It's a separate 5-day bucket and won't reduce your PTO balance. 2) Reimbursement is possible but limited — see the "Expense & Reimbursement" FAQ in the doc. 3) EU/UK and other regions: we comply with local employment laws; regional variations noted in the doc.

michael-eng: Can we take half-days or multiple short blocks?

people-ops: Yes — half-days and partial-day requests are supported. Choose "partial day" on the form and get manager signoff.

karla-people-lead: Managers: you'll get an email notif for approvals. Please be mindful — this is intended to support community engagement, not block product delivery. :thumbsup:

jin-people-ops: We're running this as a 6-month pilot. We'll collect usage metrics and qualitative feedback. Please send feedback via the form or DM me.

sam: Cool. Does this change accruals or affect other benefits?

people-ops: No changes to PTO accruals, carryover, or other benefits. Civic Leave is explicitly a separate entitlement for the pilot.

elaine: What counts as "volunteering" for proof? How strict is verification?

people-ops: Minimal friction is the goal — an event confirmation, coordinator email, or a short note should suffice. We won't require extensive paperwork.

michael-eng: Are contractors and interns included?

people-ops: Contractors are excluded for this pilot; interns are evaluated case-by-case (reach out to People Ops).

karla-people-lead: Can you share a short blurb I can post in my team channel?

people-ops: Absolutely — we'll post a 1-paragraph announcement + FAQ and a manager checklist in the next hour. Thanks all, excited to see people participate! :party-parrot:
